{{Quote|Pure cortosis gauntlet. All my Knights have them. The metal disrupts a lightsaber. Yours will be useless for the next few minutes.|Roan Fel, to Darth Kruhl|<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 13: Ready to Die">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>}}
'''Imperial Knight armor''' was the standard protection and uniform worn by [[Imperial Knight]]s. It was designed and implemented sometime between [[43 ABY]] and [[127 ABY]], after the appointment of [[Jagged Fel]] as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Fel Empire]] and before the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. The armor was [[crimson]] and [[black]], and built to withstand lightsaber strikes. It included [[Cortosis gauntlet/Legends|cortosis gauntlets]] that could shut down a lightsaber for a short period of time. Along with [[Imperial Knight lightsaber]]s, it was the identifying trait of an Imperial Knight, although Knights were known to travel in plainclothes when required. Emperor [[Roan Fel]] wore a variant of Imperial Knight armor, and [[Master armorer]] [[Hogrum Chalk]] constructed life-preserving armored suits for severely injured Imperial Knights.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|It was by the will of the Force my accident maimed me so that I might, by strength of my own will, develop my own creations.|Hogrum Chalk|<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 43: Monster, Part 1" />}}
[[File:CortosisGauntlet.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The cortosis gauntlets worn by Emperor Roan Fel, an Imperial Knight]]
Imperial Knight armor consisted of a suit of crimson<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 25: The Hidden Temple, Part 1">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> armor, that was made from the same material found in the [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. It was interwoven with small threads of [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] filament to provide additional resistance to lightsaber attacks.<ref name="LECG" /> The Imperial insignia was printed on the left shoulder pad and right gauntlet; the [[Cortosis gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] itself was composed of pure [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], rendering any lightsaber blade that touched it useless for several minutes.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 13: Ready to Die" /> The uniform also included a black hood and cape.<ref name="Legacy 2006 7">[[Legacy (2006) 7|''Legacy'' (2006) 7]]</ref> Roan Fel wore for most occasions a more elaborate variant of this armor, along with a royal cape. Nonetheless, during dangerous missions like the one on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in [[137 ABY]], he relied on the traditional and more versatile standard armor.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 13: Ready to Die" /><ref name="Legacy 2006 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref> As skilled masters of the Force, Imperial Knights knew how to get the most out of their armor.<ref name="LECG" />

The [[master armorer]] of the Imperial Knights crafted specialized life-preserving suits for Imperial Knights who had been severely injured. Master armorer [[Hogrum Chalk]] had designed at least two such suits by 137 ABY, including one for [[Azlyn Rae]]<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 43: Monster, Part 1" /> after her injuries at the hands of [[Karness Muur]]'s [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] during the [[Battle on Had Abbadon]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 31: Vector, Part 12">[[Legacy (2006) 31|''Legacy'' (2006) 31]]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Uh, who are your 'friends'?''"<br />"''They're Imperial Knights&hellip; I know&mdash;I had the same reaction.|Rogue Squadron pilots Ronto and Monia Gahan, regarding Imperial Knights Sigil Dare and Treis Sinde dressed in plainclothes|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>}}
Imperial Knight armor was developed and implemented as a standard uniform for Imperial Knights sometime after the appointment of [[Jagged Fel]] becoming ruler of the [[Fel Empire]] in or after [[45 ABY]]<ref name="Crucible novel">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref> and prior to the [[Sith–Imperial War]], which lasted from [[127 ABY]] to [[130 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" /> It was worn by all Imperial Knights, including a variation worn by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="LECG" />

Although the uniform was worn regularly when on-duty, Imperial Knights dressed in plainclothes when necessary. On her mission to the [[Hidden Temple]], and later to [[Had Abbadon]], Azlyn Rae remained in her [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] uniform, having been undercover and presumably without her regular armor.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 25: The Hidden Temple, Part 1" /><ref name="Legacy 2006 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref><ref name="Legacy 2006 28">[[Legacy (2006) 28|''Legacy'' (2006) 28]]</ref><ref name="Legacy 2006 29">[[Legacy (2006) 29|''Legacy'' (2006) 29]]</ref><ref name="Legacy 2006 30">[[Legacy (2006) 30|''Legacy'' (2006) 30]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 31: Vector, Part 12" /> [[Treis Sinde]] wore a crimson armored underwater-suit when assisting rebels on [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]],<ref name="Legacy 2006 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref> and wore plainclothes along with Sigel Dare for their undercover mission to Dac.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 22" />

In [[140 ABY]], a year after having resigned from the Imperial Knights, [[Jao Assam]] wore white-colored Imperial Knight armor.<ref name="Legacy 2013 18">[[Legacy (2013) 18|''Legacy'' (2013) 18]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KruhlUppercut.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Roan Fel's cortosis gauntlets mistakenly drawn without gloves]]
Imperial Knight armor was designed for the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' comic book by [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] comics. The armor shows a striking similarity to that of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]], especially that worn by [[Kir Kanos]] in the [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]] comic book series, also by Dark Horse, as Kanos was often portrayed without a helmet. The cortosis gauntlets of the armor are similar to the [[Vambrace/Legends|vambraces]] worn by [[Zayne Carrick]] in the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] comic book, but have different properties. Carrick's vambraces were capable of deflecting lightsaber strikes, while Imperial Knights' cortosis gauntlets deactivated lightsabers for a short period of time. Penciling or coloring mistakes sometimes portray variations of the standard Imperial Knight armor in the comic, such as Roan Fel's gloveless gauntlets in a panel of [[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]].

Art of the Imperial Knight armor by [[Jan Duursema]] utilized the work of costumer [[Thomas J. Spanos]] as a reference. Spanos also modeled for the appearance of Imperial Knight [[Ganner Krieg]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.paralada.org/Estonia_self/Estonia_htm/SWgeekhtm/IK_Ganner_Krieg/index.htm|text=Imperial Knight Ganner Krieg, costume project|archivedate=20080130082156|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30637140|board=Authors and Artists|thread=The Official Jan Duursema Discussion Thread|user=[[Jan Duursema|Jan_Duursema]]|date=2009-09-29|time=6:22 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150907193625/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-jan-duursema-discussion-thread.5915607/page-95|quote=[&hellip;] Doug Wheatley and I put out drawing brains together on creating a good look for a Chagrian female when he was drawing Chagrians in Dark Times and I was drawing Wyyrlok's daughter in Legacy.}}</ref>
